title: Algoritmi e democrazia, il caso Meta secondo lo studio di UniUrb
snippet: Press coverage detailing Professor Fabio Giglietto's research on Meta's political content reduction policies. The article discusses how his findings regarding a 72% decrease in visibility for Italian parliamentarians prompted a formal European Commission query and inquiries by Italian communications authority AGCOM.
description: Press coverage detailing Professor Fabio Giglietto's research at the University of Urbino (UniUrb) regarding Meta's political content reduction policies and its impact on Italian parliamentarians.
